callouts.title: Dirichlet收敛判别
callouts.body: $a_n:\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R},b_n:\mathbb{N} \to\mathbb{C}$,如果$a_n$单调收敛到0,并且存在正实数使得$\left|\sum_{n=1}^N b_n\right|<M$对任意正整数$N$成立，那么级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_nb_n$收敛。

if_problem.statement_en: Let $a_n:\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}$ and $b_n:\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}$. If $a_n$ decreases monotonically to $0$, and there exists a positive real number $M$ such that $\left|\sum_{n=1}^N b_n\right|<M$ for every positive integer $N$, then the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n b_n$ converges.

callouts.title: 单调性修改为有界变差
callouts.body:
1.  $a_n \to 0$(这里不需要单调的条件)
2.  $\sum_{n\geq 1}|a_n-a_{n+1}|<\infty$,即$a_n$是有界变差的。 (去掉了单调性的要求，这里用差分绝对值的和收敛替代,即$a_n$可以不单调，但是他们差分的误差累计起来要是有限的)
3.  $\left|\sum_{n=1}^N b_n\right|<\infty$ 对任意的正整数$N$成立

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Bounded variation replacement in Dirichlet-type tests
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Instead of requiring $a_n$ to be monotone, it is enough in many Dirichlet-type arguments to assume $a_n \to 0$ and $\sum_{n\geq 1}|a_n-a_{n+1}|<\infty$. This controls the total oscillation of $a_n$ and allows summation-by-parts arguments to still work.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when proving convergence of series $\sum a_n b_n$ where the partial sums of $b_n$ are uniformly bounded but the sequence $a_n$ is not monotone.

callouts.title: 去掉单调性可能会导致发散
callouts.body: $$\sum_n \frac{1}{n} = \sum_n (-1)^n \frac{(-1)^n}{n}$$令$b_n = (-1)^n$其和一定是有界的，$a_n = \frac{(-1)^n}{n} \to0$，不过 $a_n$并不单调。事实上这个级数发散。

if_problem.statement_en: Consider $$\sum_n \frac{1}{n} = \sum_n (-1)^n \frac{(-1)^n}{n}.$$ Let $b_n = (-1)^n$, whose partial sums are bounded, and let $a_n = \frac{(-1)^n}{n} \to 0$, but $a_n$ is not monotone. In fact, this series diverges.

callouts.title: 问题
callouts.body:
证明:
$$\sum_{n\geq1}\frac{(-1)^{\lfloor\sqrt{n}\rfloor}}{n}z^n$$在单位圆周$S^1$上收敛。

if_problem.statement_en: Prove that $$\sum_{n\geq1}\frac{(-1)^{\lfloor\sqrt{n}\rfloor}}{n}z^n$$ converges on the unit circle $S^1$.
prerequisites: power series on the unit circle

callouts.title: 一致收敛的问题
callouts.body:
此时的问题变成了这样:

$a_n(z):z\in D\to \mathbb{R}$,$b_n(z):z\in D\to\mathbb{C}$ 那么此时考虑级数:

$$\sum_{n} a_n(z)b_n(z)$$是否是一致收敛的。

callouts.title: 一致收敛版本的Dirichlet收敛
callouts.body:
1.  $\sum_{n =1}^{N}b_n(z)$对任意正整数$N$一致有界
2.  $a_n(z)\forall z \in D$单调收敛到0

如果满足上述条件，那么$\sum_{n} a_n(z)b_n(z)$在$D$上一致收敛。

classification_result.english_title: Uniform Convergence Version of Dirichlet Convergence

if_problem.statement_en: Assume that: 1. the partial sums $\sum_{n=1}^{N} b_n(z)$ are uniformly bounded for every positive integer $N$; 2. for every $z \in D$, the sequence $a_n(z)$ decreases monotonically to $0$. Then the series $\sum_n a_n(z)b_n(z)$ converges uniformly on $D$.
